props.text: From a delayed ferry in Cascais to an autumn table in Alfama.
We spent four hours waiting out a September Atlantic squall over shared thermos coffee and half a crossword, convinced that every detour counts twice.

props.html: Five autumns later, we are bringing family and old friends back to the hillside courtyard above the Tagus where we spent our first quiet week together.

props.html: We reserved room blocks at Memmo Príncipe Real (use code MARENTOMAS before June 1) and Casa do Carmo Guesthouse, both an eight-minute cab or scenic walk from Casa do Pátio. We recommend block heels or loafers for Lisbon cobblestones.
